sources.title: Omar Cooper set to return to practice this week for the Jets
sources.description: First round rookie wide receiver Omar Cooper is returning to practice this week per Jets head coach Aaron Glenn. Cooper suffered a high ankle sprain in the team’s Week 1 victory over the Tennessee Titans and was subsequently placed on injured reserve.This forced him to sit out at least four weeks.
